summary: SL-106 fixed the SL-087 deferrals M2 and m1. DirectoryReader.Opened is now set when Read's open returns a handle. Scanner.FailedKind(error, opened, listed) stamps UnreadableKind once in FolderDone, with a new OpenedNothingListed member appended as value 2. TopLevelRow.FailedKind and a FolderTreeSession lookup built from result.Unreadable replace the two ChildCount re-derivations, and all three surfaces now word through UnreadableRows.KindText. The acceptance test passes, the Core suite is 964/964, and the published exe still reads all 27 real code-363 rows as 'could not be opened'. A Sandbox run against the real SMB client showed the new kind on SMB folder s. The published exe never draws the new kind, because FailListingOf refuses page 1.

payload.estimate_error: Medium size and medium risk were about right. The build record says 33 files changed; the diff summary lists 28, of which 11 are in src/ and 17 are tests, rules, harness and docs. The expensive part was the fan-out around a one-bit change, not the product code: UnreadableKind has six consumers (list, tree, title, RowsMode dump, WindowCases, oracle corpus). The risk tier held, since no defect surfaced after build and the only major finding (SL-063 bug project red) was caught by the critique. If anything the first deliverable was oversized. Measuring the 'real' code-363 rows was already answered by Q-164, and the CfProvider rig cannot produce a 363 folder, so that measurement spent a survey probe and two Sandbox runs to rule out a hypothesis that was never the bug.

learned.lesson: A slice brief copied from a reflection candidate goes stale in three ways: line numbers, symbol names and counts. Check the answered-questions list and re-grep every symbol before the repro or survey stage. This brief quoted FolderTreeNode.Note at :86-90 (now :89-94), TopLevelTracker at :96 (now :98), and a 'DirectoryReader ReadOutcome' that does not exist (it is Scanner.ReadOutcome, Scanner.cs:124-133). It also quoted '28 code-363 rows' that Q-164 had already corrected to 27, failing at the open.
learned.evidence: build-check 'Things the designers should know'. Survey probe over C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp\fsa-guard-tests: 429 folders, 27 fail at the open (attrOpen=363, listOpen=363), 0 at the first query, 402 clean. Q-164 says the same.

learned.lesson: The 27 real code-363 rows are test fixtures (fsa-guard-tests, created 2026-09-18..23). They fail at CreateFile and are not instances of the opened-then-failed bug. Neither the CfProvider rig nor hand-planted cloud tags under attached cldflt (10.0.26100.9444) ever produce a first-query failure. The only natural OpenedNothingListed trigger known is an SMB server that accepts CREATE and fails QUERY_DIRECTORY (N-005's folder s). Do not spend Sandbox runs re-measuring cloud 363 for this kind.
learned.evidence: Survey probe 27/27 PHASE=open. Spike 3 states C2/C3 PHASE=open 363, patched driver stamps NothingListed. Validate W-001 over the same folder: 27 rows, 0 OpenedNothingListed. Sandbox SMB: s opens, first query 5 then 59, stamped OpenedNothingListed.

learned.lesson: A design's consumer grep for a changed public type must include tests/bugs/*. At least five bug projects (SL-063, SL-084, SL-100, SL-105, SL-106) compile App sources by link. SL-063's DoneRowFinalityTests builds TopLevelRow by reflection through the internal 9-argument constructor with no kind. The original design turned it red, because an Unreadable row with a null kind fell through TitleOf to the bare name, which in the results list reads as Done. The design's grep covered only src and tests/window.
learned.evidence: Critique M1 and m1. DoneRowFinalityTests.cs:122-127 and MadeRow :220-226. Build fixed MadeRow to set FailedKind=NothingListed. The hand mutation turned TheMarkShowsOnlyOnADoneRow red, then was restored. SL-063 10/10, SL-100 29/29, SL-105 1/1, SL-084 1/1 pass at validate.

learned.lesson: Adding a member to UnreadableKind has a fixed fan-out that the default xUnit suite (964/964) does not fully cover. The PowerShell side needs separate named runs: WindowCases CheckSeamRow (case-sensitive, fails on an unknown kind), Get-OracleRow (the new kind must be tested before the code-5 open, otherwise an opened folder is called a leak), the W-001 row-sum check, W001OracleCorpus.json (F16), RowsMode.cs, plants.json, the fitness.yaml twin, and RuleCases C-001/C-003 (settled counts move with each engine-appended rule). KindText's neutral 'could not be read' fallback and the every-kind Fact in UnreadableRowsTests are the guard for a forgotten arm. Size the next enum or kind change by this list, not by the Core diff.
learned.evidence: Build and validate ran by name: WindowCases T-007, T-003 and W-001, WindowMutants -Mutant All (12/12 killed), rules-parity (AGREE 18/22/48), RuleCases C-001/C-003, rules-harness F52/F29/F30. Code review noted Get-OracleRow ordering and the case-sensitive CheckSeamRow switch.

learned.lesson: The lesson #99 gate is red at baseline on this PC. `--filter Network=TEST-NET-1` fails 2 of 2 (CancellationTests.CancelReturnsFromAScanBlockedOnAnUnreachableShare and ...SameUnreachableShareScannedTwice, CancelsDelivered 0) identically at HEAD c6d43e0, because the scan of the unreachable address ends by itself at about 530 ms inside the root open. A scanner-touching slice therefore has no working automatic real-network cancel guard. Network=SMB-LOOPBACK is a person's run and was not run. Validate did not re-run TEST-NET-1 and relied on the build's report.
learned.evidence: builds#227 (2/2 fail on SL-106 and on an extracted HEAD copy). Code review reran it: same 2 failures. validate-slice 'not reached: --filter Network=TEST-NET-1 was not re-run'.

learned.lesson: The published exe cannot draw OpenedNothingListed: SynchronousIoCancel.FailListingOf refuses page 1 and its doc claimed a failed first page is 'a folder never opened'. The new kind was seen on the real SMB client only through a Sandbox scratch console that links Core plus the App's UnreadableRows, TopLevelRowText and FolderTreeSession sources. T-007 covers the session lookup only at ChildCount above 0 (P) and 0 (R, a refused open). Any later slice that needs the new kind in a drawn window must first change SynchronousIoCancel.cs, which lesson #214 marks high-risk.
learned.evidence: Validate 'not reached' list: criterion 11 not material by design. Design cases: the drawn OpenedNothingListed note and the opened root both marked material:false. T-007 passed (P 'only partly read' with 355 children, R 'could not be opened').

learned.lesson: An 'accepted-pending' disposition does not mean the finding was built. Two accepted findings ended as waivers: m4 (plant rows and a widened rule 2) went to SC-337, and code-review m1 (redundant FirstPageFailure.OnThisThread with a false 'process-wide static' doc) went to SC-338. The decision text for m1 said it 'belongs in this build'. So the shipped tree has a settled rule 2 that stays quiet on a kind phrase inside a longer interpolated string, which is the most likely form of a second surface wording a failed folder. It also keeps a test helper whose doc states a false premise. Read the obligation status, not the finding decision, when judging what a slice delivered.
learned.evidence: Decided findings list (m4, m1 accepted-pending) against O-019 and O-021 (waived). Code review second round: 'A phrase inside an interpolated string stays quiet; that gap was already waived'.

candidates.title: Triage the two Network=TEST-NET-1 Cancel tests that are red at HEAD
candidates.why: CancellationTests.CancelReturnsFromAScanBlockedOnAnUnreachableShare and ...SameUnreachableShareScannedTwice fail 2 of 2 under `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter Network=TEST-NET-1` (CancelsDelivered 0). They fail identically at HEAD c6d43e0 in an extracted copy (builds#227), and code review saw the scan end by itself at about 530 ms inside the root open (reviews#291). Lesson #99 makes this filter the only automatic real-network cancel guard for slices touching Scanner, DirectoryReader, SizeProbe or SynchronousIoCancel, and it cannot discriminate while it is red. Decide whether the 192.0.2.x premise still holds on this network, or replace the target.

candidates.title: Draw OpenedNothingListed in the published app: relax FailListingOf's page-1 refusal and add a window case
candidates.why: SynchronousIoCancel.FailListingOf refuses page 1 (doc corrected this slice, behaviour unchanged), so no published-exe run draws the third kind. Validate reached it only through a Sandbox scratch driver (validations#130, criterion 11). Relaxing it (FSA_HOOK_FAIL_LISTING '<leaf>|1|59') touches SynchronousIoCancel.cs, which lesson #214 marks high-risk, for one drawn row. Nothing is wrong without it: T-007 and FolderTreeSessionTests pin the lookup and the words.

candidates.title: Decide whether an opened scan root whose first page fails should end differently from a refused root
candidates.why: Scanner.ListRoot returns before AppendRoot when the root lists nothing (Scanner.cs:276-277 at HEAD of this slice). A root whose CREATE succeeds and first query fails therefore ends RootUnreadable with no UnreadableFolder. Validate measured it on the real SMB client (Sandbox run-20261013-050146 root.txt: RootUnreadable 59, no record). It shows on none of the three surfaces this slice aligned. Any change touches the ending text and ScanResult's RootError contract.

lessons_judged.why: The slice moved the stamp, the tracker, the tree and the list together. Spike 2 measured 25/25 agreement against 24/25 at HEAD, and no surface re-derives the kind from ChildCount any more.

The slice produced a new Kind on the record and did not rely on an epic 'the engine records X' verdict. The App compiled against public ScanResult.Unreadable, but nobody checked the shape from a non-friend assembly on purpose.

The critique confirmed that FolderDone is the single exit and that an aborted listing commits nothing before any stamp, and the design relied on both. The lesson's line numbers (:137-166) were stale: the stamp site is now Scanner.cs:353-393.

The repro test and the fallback-open Fact inject the failure with OverrideQueryError. Nobody tried to make real I/O fail partway. FailListingOf's page-1 refusal is the reason the published exe cannot draw the new kind.

Case C-005 pins an unasked 995 after an open as OpenedNothingListed (ListedPartway if pages were kept), and a cancelled 995 as no record. The design's error-case reasoning follows that DirectoryReader behaviour.

The '28 real code-363 rows' were exactly these test-fixture leftovers in fsa-guard-tests. The survey treated them as fixtures, found 27, and the slice never presented them as a natural instance of the bug.

The investigation did not claim a cloud positive control. The CfProvider rig produced no failing folder, so the 363 shape was rebuilt with hand-set cloud tags in the Sandbox and recorded as PHASE=open.

No new window case that creates a tree was added. T-007 and the existing cases ran unchanged. The engine-TEMP versus user-TEMP difference only affected where the build-check looked for fsa-guard-tests.
No whole-drive set-equality comparison was made. The W-001 run was over the fsa-guard-tests folder, not C:.
No Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT xUnit run was part of this slice. The CfProvider use was in scratch Sandbox runs only.
The design extended W001OracleCorpus.json with F16 and changed Get-OracleRow, rather than patching the script alone. W001OracleTests runs the corpus through the script's own function.

The lesson led to TEST-NET-1 being run in build and code review. It also exposed that the filter is already red 2/2 at HEAD, and SMB-LOOPBACK stayed a person's run, so the lesson's gate does not work on this PC today.
Window-facing checks were named and run against the published exe (T-007, T-003, WindowCases All, WindowMutants All, W-001), since dotnet test never runs them.
The harness and window-case side (WindowCases.ps1, the oracle corpus, RowsMode, plants.json) was sized and built as a main body of work, and the slice came out as 28 listed files, 17 of them non-src.
Every build, test and publish went through eng/dotnet.ps1, and the bug-project command uses it.

missed.what: Finding m2 told the build to add `--filter Network=TEST-NET-1` (with lesson #99) as a required check, without asking whether it is green at HEAD. CancellationTests.CancelReturnsFromAScanBlockedOnAnUnreachableShare and ...SameUnreachableShareScannedTwice fail 2 of 2 at HEAD c6d43e0, so the added check could not tell a regression from the baseline. A check to ask for is: run each newly required filter on the base commit before listing it as a gate.
missed.caught_by: build (builds#227, confirmed in an extracted HEAD copy) and code review (re-run)

what_went_wrong: The brief's first deliverable (measure the 28 real code-363 rows with the CfProvider rig) was already answered by Q-164: 27 rows, all failing at the open. The survey probe and two Sandbox runs (run-20261012-230925 and run-20261012-231114) re-established it, and it was never the bug. The reflection that raised the candidate did not check the answered questions.
The brief carried stale line numbers and a symbol that does not exist (DirectoryReader's ReadOutcome). Build-check had to list the corrections for the designers.

The critique ran twice: the first pass halted with 7 findings waiting on a person, and the second passed with all 7 answered by a model, so they count as untriaged (Q-251). One finding was major: the design's consumer grep stopped at src and tests/window and missed tests/bugs, where SL-063's DoneRowFinalityTests would have gone red.

Two findings decided accepted-pending, m4 (plants and a widened rule 2) and code-review m1 (redundant OnThisThread helper with a false 'process-wide static' doc), ended as waivers to SC-337 and SC-338. The shipped settled rule 2 stays quiet on a kind phrase inside a longer string, and the helper's false premise is in the tree.
Code review ran twice because round 1 halted on that extra m1 finding. Round 2 found nothing new.
The build marked O-013 discharged after a regex-only check of the F52 plant. Code review had to run the rules harness to show F52 fires in both xUnit and Fitness.

Validate relied on the build's TEST-NET-1 result instead of re-running it, although the design had said it stays in validate. Network=SMB-LOOPBACK was not run (a person's run). The new kind was never drawn by the published exe, so the tree note for OpenedNothingListed rests on a scratch driver and unit tests.
unknowns: Does a production SMB server (Windows Server, Samba, a NAS), or the Windows 10 or host build 26200 redirector, accept CREATE and fail the first QUERY_DIRECTORY? It was measured only with the SMBLibrary rig on a build 26100 Sandbox, so how often real users see 'opened, but nothing could be listed' is unknown.

Would the 27 code-363 fixture folders ever open and then fail on a different cldflt build? All measurements are on cldflt.sys 10.0.26100.9444, where they fail at CreateFile. A newer build that opened them would flip those rows to the new wording. W-001 over fsa-guard-tests is the re-check.
Do the 2 TEST-NET-1 Cancel tests fail on any network, or only because this PC's route to the unreachable address answers in about 530 ms inside the root open?
Does the published exe's tree draw the same 'opened, but nothing could be listed' note that the Sandbox scratch driver composed from Core, KindText and FolderTreeSession? No window has drawn it yet.
